_comment: Org teams kept as code (design 6.8). apply-rules.py creates or updates each team, sets its members to exactly this list and gives it 'repo_permission' on every managed repo (a team needs access to a repo before it can be asked to review there); verify-settings.py checks all of it. Teams not listed here (engineers, design) are left alone.

teams.name: Automation owners
teams.description: Assigned the issues the automation opens and asked to review bot PRs (design 6.8). The software lead for now.
